$comment: The open phases of this repository's own roadmap, as the one fact the proofs-coverage scheduling clause (tests/Fuaran.Core.Tests/ProofCoverageTests.fs, clause 2) needs: a `model-bridge` row in proofs.json whose `closes` names a phase `fuaran-core#NNN` must name an OPEN phase. The file has exactly one of two shapes: `{ "open": ["NNN", ...] }`, the ids of the open phases, or `{ "inert": "<reason>" }`, a declaration that no list is kept. The roadmap store is not in this repository and cannot be, so nothing here can read it; the clause used to read a private projection's rendered index through an environment variable that public CI never set, and this file replaces that. While the file is inert a row that makes a scheduling claim FAILS the clause rather than passing, because a scheduling claim nothing can check must not read as green. No row carries a phase-form `closes` today, so the clause is vacuous on today's data and the suite says so. Replace the inert form with the list when a writer for it exists.
inert: no roadmap side writes this list yet and this repository cannot read one, so none is kept
